question: how much did we make last year
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024'

question: rev for the north in h1 2025
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND r.region_name='North' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30'

question: Which region missed its 2025 revenue target by the most?
gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT c.region_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)) rev FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY c.region_id), b AS (SELECT region_id, SUM(revenue_budget) bud FROM budgets WHERE month LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY region_id) SELECT r.region_name FROM regions r JOIN a USING(region_id) JOIN b USING(region_id) ORDER BY a.rev - b.bud ASC LIMIT 1

question: What % of our 2025 revenue came from Enterprise customers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.segment='Enterprise' THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount) END) / SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)), 1) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025'

question: By how many dollars did Technology revenue change from 2024 to 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount) ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category='Technology'

question: best selling product last quarter by revenue
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers placed at least one order in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025'

question: What's our return rate for 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders o WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025'

question: cancelled orders in q2 2024 - how many
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.status='cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30'

question: Which customers haven't ordered anything since September 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING MAX(o.order_date) < '2025-10-01'

question: Total spend on software across all departments in 2025
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM expenses WHERE category='Software' AND substr(expense_date,1,4)='2025'

question: Marketing spend Q4 2025 vs Q4 2024
gold_sql: SELECT substr(expense_date,1,4) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM expenses WHERE department='Marketing' AND substr(expense_date,6,2) IN ('10','11','12') GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

question: Which month in 2025 had the highest sales?
gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: open receivables that aren't overdue yet
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount - amount_paid),2) FROM invoices WHERE status='open'

question: Gross profit for furniture in 2025
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount) - p.unit_cost)),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND p.category='Furniture'

question: Top 3 products in the West by revenue for 2025
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)),2) rev FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND r.region_name='West' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 3

question: How much budget did the East have for 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(b.revenue_budget),2) FROM budgets b JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=b.region_id WHERE r.region_name='East' AND b.month LIKE '2025-%'

question: Which segment has the highest average order value in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Revenue from Safety Equipment in Q3 2025 in the South
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category='Safety Equipment' AND r.region_name='South' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'

question: operating expenses as a percentage of revenue, 2025
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM expenses WHERE substr(expense_date,1,4)='2025') / (SELECT SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025'), 1)

question: number of invoices overdue by more than 90 days
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status='overdue' AND due_date < date('2025-12-31', '-90 days')

question: What's the average invoice amount for Enterprise customers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.amount),2) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.segment='Enterprise'

question: Show me 2025 revenue by quarter
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY (CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 ORDER BY (CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3

question: how many units of the ergonomic chair did we sell in 2025
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND p.product_name='Ergonomic Office Chair'

question: Which customer has the largest single unpaid invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE i.status <> 'paid' ORDER BY i.amount - i.amount_paid DESC LIMIT 1
